name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish inventor and physicist who developed Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) technology.

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Author of the essay and researcher at VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland.

name: Jorma Antson
summary: Colleague of Suntola who worked on the humidity sensor and EL development.

name: Tapio Wiik
summary: Colleague of Suntola assigned to make a pre-study on humidity sensing.

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at Helsinki University of Technology who supervised Suntola's early work.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Closest co-worker to Suntola in ALE reactor design since 1975 and co-founder of Picosun Oy.

name: Arto Pakkala
summary: Colleague involved in the successful demonstration of the ZnCl2/H2S process.

name: Tapio Alvesalo
summary: Head of the venture team at Neste Advanced Power Systems (NAPS).

name: Antti Piippo
summary: Business-oriented manager invited to Lohja's Display Electronics division.

name: Ahti Aintila
summary: Developer of driving circuitries and manufacturing technology for EL panels.

name: Jaakko Hyvärinen
summary: Developer of solar simulators at Microchemistry, later founded Endeas Oy.

name: Matti Ervasti
summary: Business-oriented managing director invited to take care of Microchemistry.

name: Kustaa Poutiainen
summary: Co-founder of Picosun Oy with Sven Lindfors.

name: Pekka Soininen
summary: Started the ALE reactor activity in Beneq Oy.

name: Jun-ichi Nishizawa
summary: Japanese professor who realized the significance of ALE and started MLE research.

name: Lauri Niinistö
summary: Professor of inorganic and analytical chemistry at HUT who organized the first ALE conference.

name: Victor Drozd
summary: Researcher who invited Suntola to visit the University of Leningrad.

name: Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet inventor of the 'molecular layering' technique.

name: Kolt'sov
summary: Soviet inventor of the 'molecular layering' technique.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University where Suntola studied and later worked as an assistant teacher.

name: VTT Semiconductor Laboratory
summary: Laboratory established in 1964 where Suntola worked in the early 1970s.

name: Vaisala Oy
summary: Finnish company specializing in meteorological instrumentation.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Company where Suntola established a research group in 1974.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Building material company that acquired the ALE-EL project in 1978.

name: Planar Inc.
summary: American competitor that bought Lohja's EL business in 1990.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that acquired Planar's EL plant in Olarinluoma in 2012.

name: Neste Oy
summary: National oil company that established Microchemistry Ltd.

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Company founded in 1987 to develop ALE-based solar panels and reactors.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that bought Microchemistry in 1999.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Company set up by Sven Lindfors and Kustaa Poutiainen in 2004.

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Tuomo Suntola was born.

name: Espoo
summary: City in Finland where Instrumentarium and Lohja facilities were located.

name: Lohja
summary: City in Finland where Lohja Oy had a plant.

name: Helsinki-Vantaa airport
summary: Airport where the first large information boards were installed.

name: Leningrad
summary: City in Russia (then Soviet Union) where Suntola visited Aleskovskii.

name: San Diego
summary: City in California where the SID conference was held.

name: Boston
summary: City where the MRS 1994 Annual Meeting was held.

name: Munich
summary: City where the Munich Electronics Show 2004 was held.

name: Humicap 1 sensor
summary: Humidity sensor developed by Suntola and Antson based on a thin polymer film.

name: ALE reactor (T-piece)
summary: The first ALE reactor built in 1974 using a 12" T-piece.

name: ALE Patent (1974)
summary: International patent on ALE filed on November 29, 1974.

name: ALE Patent (1979)
summary: Second international ALE patent with priority date Feb 28, 1979.

name: F-120 reactor
summary: Compact research reactor designed for photovoltaic development, became the first commercial ALD reactor.

name: EL display boards (Helsinki-Vantaa)
summary: Large information boards installed at Helsinki-Vantaa airport in 1983.

name: The Dynamic Universe
summary: Book published by Suntola in 2011 on a holistic picture of reality.

name: The Short History of Science
summary: Book published by Suntola in 2012 linking philosophy and historical development.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring Suntola as a Pioneer in Atomic Layer Deposition Techniques.
